summary: Executed backend + frontend regression on public preview URL for villager lifecycle, FIFO market economy, and updated sunset map. Backend passed fully (12/12). Frontend loaded correctly with sunset/ocean world and no mobile overflow, but crew deployment dialog interaction failed repeatedly in automation, blocking full deploy-flow verification.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete rod/net/boat deployment path due crew-card click actionability failure; requires manual/interactive revalidation by main agent.

issues: Sunset sky, clouds, and ocean render correctly with no blank void observed.

action_items: Fix crew dialog card actionability/race so character cards are reliably clickable after opening crew modal.
Main agent should manually re-run full UI deploy regression (rod/net/boat) on desktop+mobile after crew dialog fix.
Optionally add deterministic UI state marker when crew dialog is open and ready for selection to improve automation reliability.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend economy/villager logic is solid under deterministic and API regression tests: FIFO batches, no oversell, and pause/speed behavior validated.
Frontend has good testid coverage, but crew modal interaction appears flaky under automation despite elements rendering; likely overlay/focus/actionability race.
No backend 500s, no BSON _id leakage, and no auth/session guard regressions observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not spend more cycles on character-card selector retries without code change; 3 consecutive failures already occurred in this run. Backend regression is now expanded to 12 tests including villager lifecycle/FIFO/pause-speed checks and all pass.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: PLAY -> free demo -> attempt to open crew modal via empty-crew/add-crew/nav-crew -> character-card-rod click times out repeatedly. Observed state: game world active, HUD visible, modal behavior inconsistent under automation; mobile run showed crew modal visually present but downstream flow remained blocked in automation. Likely modal actionability/focus/overlay race rather than backend failure (backend APIs passed and no server errors).
